episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Jesse struggles to escape a past that is slowly catching up to him. A mysterious entity comes to earth, leaving a wave of destruction in its wake.

episodes.title: See
episodes.summary: Jesse begins to realize that he has a special gift after learning of Ted's death. Meanwhile, Fiore and DeBlanc come looking for Jesse, and Cassidy takes extreme steps to stop them.

episodes.title: The Possibilities
episodes.summary: Jesse revels his power to Cassidy, who soon makes a deal with Fiore and DeBlanc. Meanwhile, the town starts to talk about Tracy opening her eyes, and whisper behind Donnie's back about what Jesse did to him.

episodes.title: Monster Swamp
episodes.summary: Cassidy tries to keep Fiore and DeBlanc off of Jesse after they express their willingness to cut open the preacher with a chainsaw. Meanwhile, Jesse approaches Odin with an offer: the church land if Odin doesn't accept God.

episodes.title: South Will Rise Again
episodes.summary: Jesse sets out to use the Voice to solve the troubles of the people of Annville. Meanwhile, Odin agrees to a meeting with the Green Acres people, Donnie realizes what he's up against, and Tulip and Cassidy begin a relationship.

episodes.title: Sundowner
episodes.summary: After DeBlanc and Fiore tell Jesse about the source of the Voice, they receive a visit from a higher angel. Meanwhile, Emily and Tulip bond, and Eugene asks Jesse to take back what he did.

episodes.title: He Gone
episodes.summary: Jesse tries to deal with what he did to Eugene, while Odin insists that he hasn't become a Christian and demands that Jesse turn the church over to him.

episodes.title: El Valero
episodes.summary: The townspeople gather to watch Odin and the Meat Men try to take the church. Meanwhile, Jesse receives a visitor and calls upon Fiore and DeBlanc to remove Genesis from him.

episodes.title: Finish the Song
episodes.summary: Jesse escapes police custody and steals the angels' line to Heaven so that he can summon God to Texas. Meanwhile, Tulip tells Emily what Cassidy really is, Miles pays Emily a visit, and the true nature of the Cowboy's fate is revealed.

episodes.title: Call and Response
episodes.summary: Jesse prepares to summon God to Annville, but soon realizes that you can't always get what you want.

episodes.title: On the Road
episodes.summary: Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy hit the road in search of God, and quickly realize they're being stalked by a killer cowboy from Hell.

episodes.title: Mumbai Sky Tower
episodes.summary: Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy find Fiore working as a magician in Las Vegas, and try to convince him to answer their questions about the Cowboy.

episodes.title: Damsels
episodes.summary: While Jesse searches jazz clubs in New Orleans for God, Cassidy finds a play for them to crash. However, Tulip soon realizes that she can't escape her past. Meanwhile, Eugene suffers in Hell.

episodes.title: Viktor
episodes.summary: Jesse spots the actor who played God in an infomercial and tracks him down. Meanwhile, Tulip meets with Viktor.

episodes.title: Dallas
episodes.summary: As Jesse considers what to do with Viktor, he and Tulip remember the past after they lost the baby.

episodes.title: Sokosha
episodes.summary: Jesse and his friends discover what the Cowboy wants, and are forced to deal with him when he captures Denis.

episodes.title: Pig
episodes.summary: Tulip has nightmares of the Cowboy's touch, and finds a unique way to deal with them. Meanwhile, Jesse seeks out a doomsday preacher for advice on selling 1% of his soul, and the origin of Herr Starr's entry into the Grail is revealed.

episodes.title: Holes
episodes.summary: While Cassidy considers what to do with Denis, Tulip spackles the bulletholes that the Cowboy left in the walls. Meanwhile, Jesse goes to a video store to try and determine whose gun was used to kill Mark Harelik.

episodes.title: Puzzle Piece
episodes.summary: After the Grail's first assault on Jesse and his friends fail, they unleash BRAD. Meanwhile, Tulip's PSD continues to get worse, and Denis revels in his new health.

episodes.title: Dirty Little Secret
episodes.summary: Jesse finally meets the Messiah face-to-face, but he isn't what Jesse expects. Meanwhile, Lara works to create a divide between Tulip and Jesse, while Denis gives in to his new appetites.

episodes.title: Backdoors
episodes.summary: Jesse realizes where God is and goes to find Him, but discovers that He is already gone. Meanwhile, Hitler shows Eugene a way out of Hell, and Tulip resolves to destroy the Cowboy's guns.

episodes.title: On Your Knees
episodes.summary: After the Grail frees the Cowboy, he comes looking for Jesse. Meanwhile, Eugene comes to terms with his past so that he and Hitler can escape Hell.

episodes.title: The End of the Road
episodes.summary: Starr puts Jesse on the path to messiahdom. Meanwhile, Cassidy deals with Denis and Tulip finds out who has been spying on them.

episodes.title: Angelville
episodes.summary: Jesse takes Tulip to Gran'ma and makes a deal to have her resurrected.

episodes.title: Sonsabitches
episodes.summary: When Tulip captures FJ and Lara, Jesse secretly turns them loose as a bargaining chip to get Starr to return his soul. Meanwhile, Tulip deals with the aftermath of her resurrection, and the Boyds pay Angelville a visit.

episodes.title: Gonna Hurt
episodes.summary: Jesse falls back on his old ways, while Tulip goes to the Boyds in an attempt to find a way to break Jesse's blood compact with Marie.

episodes.title: The Tombs
episodes.summary: Jesse tries to get Cassidy out of the Tombs, while Sabina tells Tulip about her history with Jesse and the L'Angelles. In Hell, Satan has a talk with the Saint.

episodes.title: The Coffin
episodes.summary: Jesse is put in the Coffin and tries to find a way out. Meanwhile, Tulip plots to kill Marie, Cassidy goes on a date, and Starr gets a call from his superior.

episodes.title: Les Enfants du Sang
episodes.summary: Jesse convinces Jody and T.C. to help him and Tulip rob Sabina's bank to get the souls to keep Marie--and Tulip--alive. Meanwhile, Eccarius shows Cassidy what a vampire can do when he puts his mind to it, and Starr continues plotting his coup against Allfather.

episodes.title: Hilter
episodes.summary: Jesse brokers a deal between Starr and Marie: souls for Marie, freedom for Jesse. Meanwhile, FJ takes a squad of priests after Cassidy, and the Saint finds Hitler.

episodes.title: The Tom / Brady
episodes.summary: Allfather captures Jesse and tries to transfer Genesis from him into Humperdoo. Meanwhile, Tulip, Lara, and Jody steal the souls while Satan makes a new deal with Marie.

episodes.title: Schwanzkopf
episodes.summary: Jesse engages in Allfather in final battle to determine the fate of the world. Meanwhile, Eccarius turns the Children against Cassidy, and Tulip plots to escape a trip to Hell.

episodes.title: The Light Above
episodes.summary: Jesse avenges his father and gives Marie her just due; Tulip faces off against Nazis; and Cassidy accepts Eccarius' offer.

episodes.title: Masada
episodes.summary: Jesse and Tulip fight their way into Masada to rescue Cassidy, but Cassidy has other ideas while his torturer removes his bits and pieces.

episodes.title: Last Supper
episodes.summary: Jesse realizes that he has to go to Australia to find the Lost Apostle, and pays a visit to the House of Entertainment. Left to her own devices, Tulip comes up with a plan to enter Masada. Cassidy comes up with a cunning plan to escape put his own guilt thwarts him.

episodes.title: Deviant
episodes.summary: Jesse tries to rescue the boy from the House, Tulip undergoes a psychiatric evaluation, Cassidy thinks of home, and Eugene tries to make small talk with the Saint.

episodes.title: Search and Rescue
episodes.summary: Jesse and Steve are lost on a life raft in the middle of the ocean after their plane goes down, and Steve wonders if he'll survive. Tulip has a come-to-Jesus moment with Jesus in Masada, and Cassidy makes Frankie sit things out.

episodes.title: Bleak City
episodes.summary: Tulip finds Cassidy, the Archangel finds his demon lover, Eugene and the Saint find Jesse, and Jesse finds Eugene. Jesus wants to go to Vegas, and Hitler plays handball.

episodes.title: The Lost Apostle
episodes.summary: Impatient with the lack of progress between Jesus and Hitler, Starr heads to Australia to meet with God... who is luring Jesse and his friends into a trap at Lost Apostle.

episodes.title: Messiahs
episodes.summary: Jesse finds himself in Heaven after his death, and learns of God's plans for phase 3 of Creation. Tulip and Cassidy search for the one person that they can use as leverage against God. Starr pursues the dingo that bit off his genitals, and Hoover Two reveals his true loyalties.

episodes.title: Fear of the Lord
episodes.summary: Jesse suffers the tortures of the damned in Hell as Fiore tries to convince him to take the throne of God. Tulip waits for God to appear so that she can kill Humperdoo in front of Him, and Starr has a meal with the Chunt brothers.

episodes.title: Overture
episodes.summary: Starr and the Grail put on their Apocalypse Revue, and the clock counts down to Humperdoo's big number... and God's big number on the world. Jesse, Tulip, and Cassidy sneak into Masada to get Humperdoo, but God has other plans. And Eugene's post-prison plans are cut short.

episodes.title: End of the World
episodes.summary: As the Apocalypse draws nigh, Jesse fights the Saint, Tulip fights Cassidy, Jesus fights Hitler, Lara goes up against Starr, and God waits in the stands.
